material_findings: The first live NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET exception occurred exactly at the prior 1/3 theory-backward boundary identified by Methodology R25.
SUB created no candidate, research branch, scientific workflow, claim ceiling, readiness state, or consumed identity and did not count the exception as MECHANISM work.

The exception rationale names concrete excluded alternatives: unfixed H7 native contract/falsifier, MAIN-owned SYSTEM work, terminal/exactly-reduced nearby mechanism families, and low-information source-transparent recurrence/readout probes.
SUB requires fresh opportunity-local reassessment rather than mechanically copying the exception.
Evidence Analyst and Control independently classify the first live exception as credible while preserving the actual-selection window at 1/3 and canonical candidate population at 22/22.

Current MAIN SYSTEM lease records system_priority_exception.used=false and the no-comparable-MECHANISM basis before prospective-contract mutation; this is not a genuine SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM exception.
false_positive_risks: Repeated NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET no-ops could make the actual-selection rolling window remain at 1/3 indefinitely unless exception opportunities are separately observable and freshly justified.
A future SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM run could still be post-hoc justified unless its machine-readable exception is persisted before execution; no genuine live exception has yet occurred.
SYSTEM reproducibility work could be over-read as mechanism/novelty evidence unless claim-type separation remains enforced.

false_negative_risks: Do not force a MECHANISM object merely to satisfy the rolling floor; a specifically justified no-target no-op is preferable when all available targets are incoherent, duplicative, MAIN-colliding, terminal, or reduction-by-construction.
Do not suppress bounded SYSTEM architecture/reproducibility work when no comparable executable/informative MECHANISM exists.
Do not require positive signal or prior comparator/reduction victory merely to become preformal_eligible or READY.
Do not universalize claim-specific external-validation comparator/resampling requirements to unrelated bounded Discovery.
